summary.text: Angelica Rubio is a Democratic state representative from District 35 who has represented the district since 2017 and is seeking re-election in the New Mexico House of Representatives in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She is a nonprofit consultant who holds degrees from New Mexico State University and California State University, Los Angeles.

paragraphs.text: Angelica Rubio earned a bachelor's degree in government from New Mexico State University and an M.A. in Latin American studies from California State University, Los Angeles.
Her professional experience includes owning Angelica Rubio Consulting, interning on Capitol Hill and working as a campaign manager.

For 2025-2026 she is assigned to the Consumer and Public Affairs Committee, as vice chair, and the Agriculture, Acequias and Water Resources Committee, and she chaired the Transportation, Public Works and Capital Improvements Committee in 2021-2022.
